description: Consumer Affairs Authority - Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG) Domestic Cylinder 18 liters maximum Retail Prices
reasoning: This gazette content is an order issued by the Consumer Affairs Authority under Section 20(5) of the Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No. 09 of 2003. It establishes regulatory price controls for Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG) cylinders across various districts. This constitutes a regulatory framework and compliance requirement, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) rather than government personnel/structure categories.
